findings.value: A historic listed building on Commercial Road in Stepney that now hosts concerts, club nights and other events. It opened in 1933 as a cinema, later served as an opera school and as a bingo hall.

evidence.quote: The Grade II-listed, art deco music venue
It spent time as an opera school and a bingo hall

findings.value: Concerts and club nights, alongside MMA fights and immersive cinema.

evidence.quote: including MMA fights, immersive cinema, club nights and a huge range of live music concerts

findings.value: Says everyone is welcome, and that its team works hard to keep the place respectful and welcoming for all.

evidence.quote: make sure your visit is relaxed, welcoming and accessible
Troxy worked hard to create a respectful and welcoming environment for everyone

notes: Time Out's review of 10 March 2023 carries a 'More: Temporarily closed' keyword in its page metadata, not in its visible text; it is old and cannot back status. Troxy's own what's-on page lists events into 2027, so it appears to be trading. Time Out's 2016 guide says 3,050 capacity; the venue's own page says 3,600, so capacity is not proposed here. Mixmag (24 June 2025) reports a refurbishment underway; no closure.
